info.title: v2.product.get_item_list_by_content_diagnosis
info.description: Query the list of products and their content quality details by content quality level or content issues.

post.description: Query the list of products and their content quality details by content quality level or content issues.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: issue_type
parameters.description: Item's content issue. Applicable values: 1: TOO_FEW_IMAGES 2: WRONG_CATEGORY 3: TOO_FEW_ATTRIBUTES_FOR_QUALIFIED 4: LACK_OF_SIZE_CHART 5: LACK_OF_STANDARD_VARIATION 6: LACK_BRAND 7: TOO_SHORT_DESCRIPTION 8: TOO_SHORT_OR_TOO_LONG_NAME 9: WRONG_WEIGHT 10: LACK_OF_VIDEO 11: TOO_FEW_ATTRIBUTES_FOR_EXCELLENT If you need to pass both quality_level and issue_type, the logic are as follows: - When quality_level is 1, issue_type can only be 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 - When quality_level is 2, issue_type can only be 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 - When quality_level is 3, issue_type can only be empty

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is empty. if data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: the size of one page. Max=48

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: quality_level
parameters.description: Item's latest content quality level. Applicable values: 1: TO_BE_IMPROVED 2: QUALIFIED 3: EXCELLENT

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
